comment: The toolchains of session-store that no other file declares. npm is declared in the devEngines.packageManager of package.json and Rust in rust-toolchain.toml. mise is the release that make install-tools TOOLS=npm installs with the sha256 of each platform; mise.toml declares the tools it installs and mise.lock locks them. bay is the release that make install-bay installs for CI with the sha256 of each platform.

bay.comment: The release of bay that CI installs (make install-bay), with the sha256 of its archive of each platform: a runner holds no bay, and a download is used only by its pinned digest. No run reads this pin; a run starts the bay of its machine and fails a document of bay whose schemaVersion is not the one that the harness reads (SE-10.4). The pin is raised to a later release that the tests of CI need, and it is removed when a runner gives bay or the tests start no server.
